class P(tp.InlineProcessor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('backtick', ip.BACKTICK_RE)
        self.calls = []

        self.calls.append((m.span(0), data[m.start(0):m.end(0)]))

    data, matched, startIndex = p.__applyPattern(p, data, 0, startIndex)
    count += 1
    if not matched or count > 20:

    print('iter', count, 'matched at startIndex', startIndex)
print('final', data)
